comment: The pages of the sidechains built into the Chains app (doc/unified-app.md §13): each pack from its repository at a pinned commit (never a branch), in the folder <repos>/<repo> (WEBUI_SIDECHAIN_REPOS, default: next to this repository). Bump a commit to take a newer version of a sidechain's pages; the build checks each speaks this app's hostApi and was made with this app's interface kit (the same packages).
